pwa_description: The team’s calendar, clients and reminders, at hand on a phone.
pwa_ios_steps: In Safari, tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”.
pwa_offline_lead: There is no connection right now. Pages you opened recently can still be read; the rest loads when you are back online.
pwa_page_lead: You choose what this device receives. Nothing starts without your say.
pwa_topic_articles_hint: A short note when a new article appears.
pwa_ios_install: On iPhone and iPad, notifications work once you add the app to your Home Screen (iOS 16.4 or later).
pwa_off: Notifications are not available right now.
pwa_denied: Your browser has blocked notifications for this app. You can allow them in the site settings.
pwa_failed: That did not work this time. Please try again in a little while.
pwa_tested: Sent. It should appear in a few seconds.
pwa_too_soon: You just asked for one; give it a moment.
pwa_privacy: A notification never names a client or the reason for a visit, only that there is news.
pwa_push_test_body: This is how news from the console will reach you.
pwa_topic_requests_hint: When someone asks for an appointment or leaves a message on the site.
pwa_topic_appointments_hint: When an appointment is added, moved or cancelled for you.
pwa_push_clinic_request_title: A new request reached the console
pwa_push_clinic_appointment_body: Open the Calendar to see what changed.
pwa_push_clinic_reminder_body: The list is ready in Reminders.
